steps.name: Implement directional padding layout and hit-test dispatch
steps.criteria: padding(x:y:) modifier applies horizontal (x) and vertical (y) padding independently using content-box semantics: outer frame = content frame + 2*x width + 2*y height. layoutNode and hitTestNode dispatch through AnyDirectionalPaddingModifier. Deprecated AnyPaddingModifier branch and its helpers (layoutPaddingNode, outerSizeForPaddedContent) are removed. PaddingModifier conforms to AnyDirectionalPaddingModifier. All acceptance tests in DirectionalPaddingTests.swift pass.
steps.scenario_name: Walking skeleton — padding(x:y:) on framed view produces correct outer frame
